```{r}
library(lme4); library(lmerTest)

out_dir <- "C:/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive - Harvard University/snu_remains/redo/ccrem_rerun"
dl <- read.csv(file.path(out_dir, "data_long_for_R.csv"))
dl$ID        <- factor(dl$ID)
dl$INFLOW_CD <- factor(dl$INFLOW_CD)
fml <- readLines(file.path(out_dir, "formulas.txt"))
```

```{r}
ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))
fit  <- lmer(as.formula(fml[1]), data = dl, weights = w, REML = TRUE, control = ctrl)

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x
print(isSingular(fit)); print(VarCorr(fit)); print(summary(rePCA(fit)))
print(VarCorr(fit)); print(summary(rePCA(fit)))
# Optimizer check
fit_nm <- update(fit, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))
cat("Max abs diff in fixed effects:", max(abs(fixef(fit) - fixef(fit_nm))), "\n")
cat("logLik BOBYQA:", logLik(fit), " | Nelder-Mead:", logLik(fit_nm), "\n")

# LR test for Female x Age and Female x Age^2
fit_noFA <- lmer(as.formula(fml[2]), data = dl, weights = w, REML = TRUE, control = ctrl)
lrt <- anova(fit_noFA, fit)
print(lrt)
write.csv(as.data.frame(lrt), file.path(out_dir, "lrt_female_age.csv"))

# Save results for Python
coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(fit)$coefficients)
coefs$term <- rownames(coefs)
write.csv(coefs, file.path(out_dir, "ccrem_coefficients_raw.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(as.matrix(vcov(fit)), file.path(out_dir, "ccrem_vcov.csv"))

vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit))
var_f   <- var(as.vector(model.matrix(fit) %*% fixef(fit)))
var_id  <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "ID"]
var_org <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "INFLOW_CD"]
var_res <- sigma(fit)^2
tot <- var_f + var_id + var_org + var_res
fitstats <- data.frame(
  quantity = c("Park (ID) intercept variance", "Origin gu (INFLOW_CD) intercept variance",
               "Residual variance", "ICC park", "ICC origin",
               "Marginal R2", "Conditional R2", "AIC", "BIC", "logLik",
               "N obs", "N parks", "N origin gu"),
  value = c(var_id, var_org, var_res,
            var_id / (var_id + var_org + var_res), var_org / (var_id + var_org + var_res),
            var_f / tot, (var_f + var_id + var_org) / tot,
            AIC(fit), BIC(fit), as.numeric(logLik(fit)),
            nobs(fit), nlevels(dl$ID), nlevels(dl$INFLOW_CD)))
write.csv(fitstats, file.path(out_dir, "ccrem_fit_stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Done\n")
```
